messages:
sara.k: Heads up — saw entries from other orgs showing up in Org-A's quota graph on the console. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/abc123 :eyes:
jon: whoa. repro steps?
SARA.K: repro: switch to org-a, open /console/usage -> panel shows a small spike labelled org-b, hover tooltip shows org-b id. Hitting the metrics API directly returns rows tagged with org-b even when X-ORG-ID: org-a. Example:
```
curl -H \"X-ORG-ID: org-a\" \"https://console.internal/api/metrics?panel=quota\" | jq '.rows[] | select(.org_id!=\"org-a\")'
```
tyler: this smells like the prefetch cache key — last change normalized path but I think we dropped tenant header from key composition in prefetch-v2. Edge cache uses the prefetch payload as cache key.
eva: FWIW we started a canary for prefetch-v2 yesterday at 30%. I flagged a small telemetry blip but didn't connect the dots.
matt: rolling back canary now — will coordinate with infra.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for service=console-prefetch, from v2.1.0 -> v2.0.8, target canary=0%
jon: immediate mitigation: invalidate prefetch/console cache keys for the last 24h and add a gateway guard that refuses to serve cached responses unless X-ORG-ID header matches the org encoded in the cached payload. I'll sketch a PR.
tyler: quick patch idea: if cached_entry.headers.x-org-id != incoming X-ORG-ID -> return 412 and bypass cache. Also add unit test asserting key includes X-ORG-ID. I'll add tests to router-key-suite.
eva: we should also scan metrics and dashboards for leaked org ids over the past 7 days and notify CS+security. If any PII surfaced, escalate.
sara.k: agreed. jon — please open an incident and ping CS. Also list the cache prefixes to evict: console-panel-prefetch:* and prefetch-response:console-*.
jon: on it. Creating INC-2026-48 with repro steps, curl snippet, suggested quick fix + longer-term plan (add tenant assertion in routing policy, add canary e2e). ETA 30m.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete. stable=v2.0.8, canary=0%, status=healthy.
sara.k: thanks all. Followups: postmortem, add synthetic isolation canaries that run during rollouts, and add a telemetry regression alert specifically for cross-tenant matches. Filing follow-ups now. :thumbsup:
